    All Classes and Interfaces

    Class
    Description
    AcceptedEntry
    One accepted finding in the committed ledger, with its expected count.
    BomImportModelObserver
    Observes every file-stage model Maven reads and records reactor coordinates plus import-scoped POM dependencies into ModelObservations, for session-end cross-referencing by BuildReportSpy.
    BuildReportSpy
    Routes structured build events into ReportSession, which writes the ike꞉build-report.md receipt at session end.
    Finding
    One observation derived from a structured build event.
    FindingCategory
    The structured event family a Finding was derived from.
    GateKeeper
    Session-end gate enforcement (ike-issues#989).
    GateVerdict
    The session's enforcement outcome, computed exactly once when the receipt is written.
    Ledger
    The committed acceptance ledger, normally read from .mvn/build-report.yaml at the execution root.
    LedgerEvaluation
    The result of comparing a session's findings against a Ledger.
    LedgerEvaluation.AcceptedStatus
    One ledger entry with its observation count for this session.
    LedgerEvaluation.AttentionItem
    One unaccepted or count-exceeding warning key.
    LedgerMode
    Enforcement posture declared by a ledger.
    LedgerWriter
    Canonical serializer for the acceptance ledger.
    ModelCrossReference
    Derives MODEL findings from file-model observations at session end.
    ModelObservations
    Session-scoped bridge between the two dependency-injection systems this extension spans.
    ModelObservations.BomImport
    One import-scoped POM dependency observed in a file model.
    ModelObservations.FileModel
    One file-stage model observation.
    ObservationsFile
    The machine-readable observations sidecar (target/build-report-observations.yaml): per-key observed counts from the latest session, written beside the human receipt so downstream tooling (the ratchet goal) derives from data instead of scraping rendered Markdown.
    RatchetPlanner
    Computes the downward-only tightening of a ledger against the latest session's observed counts.
    RatchetPlanner.Plan
    A computed ratchet plan.
    RatchetPlanner.Tightening
    One proposed tightening.
    ReceiptRenderer
    Renders a LedgerEvaluation as the ike꞉build-report.md receipt, in the house ws꞉*.md receipt style: a title line, a tool/version/timestamp line, then only the sections that have content.
    ReportSession
    Session-scoped state and finalization shared by the two components that must cooperate at session end: BuildReportSpy (event collection, SessionEnded) and GateKeeper (afterSessionEnd enforcement).
    Severity
    How a Finding participates in ledger evaluation.
